title: Specific Heat Capacity — Units & Dimensional Formula
topicTitle: Measurement of specific heat capacity of solids and liquids
notes: **SI unit:** J·kg⁻¹·K⁻¹ (equivalently J·kg⁻¹·°C⁻¹ since it's a temperature *difference*)
Being independent of mass in the dimensional formula reflects that c is an *intensive* property — a property of the material, not the amount of it
